notes.title: Version 1.5.0 - game modes!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce a major update to Super Bombinhas - the game difficulty modes!
Now, when starting the game, you'll be able to choose between [b]Old School[/b] and [b]Casual[/b]. 

In the [b]Old School[/b] mode, you have a limited number of lives, and a game over will set you back to the beginning of the last world you reached!

In the [b]Casual[/b] mode, there is no lives limit - try and retry a section as many times as you need. In this mode, the lives have been replaced with other useful items, making the journey a bit easier too.

This version also improves some parts of the level design and the level editor.

Enjoy!
